name: MM Finance Cronos
rootCause: Mad Meerkat Finance (not to be confused with normal Meerkat Finance) lost $2M to a DNS exploit. Back-end attacks, front-end attacks, when will we see the end of the attacks?

descriptions.text: Mad Meerkat Finance (not to be confused with normal Meerkat Finance) lost $2M to a DNS exploit. Back-end attacks, front-end attacks, when will we see the end of the attacks?

According to the official release, the MM.finance website was hit by a DNS attack, and the attacker managed to inject malicious contract addresses into the front-end code. The attacker exploited the DNS vulnerability to modify the router contract address in the escrow file, and digital assets worth more than $2,000,000 were stolen, bridged to the Ethereum network through multi-chain, and then laundered through Tornado Cash.

On May 4, 2022, MM Finance on Cronos suffered a DNS hijack of its frontend, allowing an attacker to substitute a malicious router contract address, divert user funds, and bridge proceeds to Ethereum. Approximately $2 million was stolen; backend protocol contracts remained uncompromised. The attacker exploited a DNS vulnerability to alter MM Finance's frontend, injecting a malicious router contract address. Users interacting with the compromised website unknowingly routed tokens to the attacker's wallet.
